mapper.select: SELECT dept_id, dept_name, dept_code, parent_id, tree_path, `sort`, `status`, `is_deleted`, `create_id`, `update_id`, create_time, update_time FROM sys_department WHERE dept_id = ( SELECT CASE WHEN parent_id = 0 THEN dept_id ELSE CAST( SUBSTRING_INDEX( SUBSTRING_INDEX( tree_path, ',', 2 ), ',', - 1 ) AS UNSIGNED ) END AS dept_id FROM sys_department WHERE dept_id = #{deptId} )

SELECT * FROM sys_department
is_deleted = 0
AND `status` = #{status}
AND ( dept_id = #{deptId} OR FIND_IN_SET( #{deptId},tree_path ))

SELECT GROUP_CONCAT( d.dept_name ORDER BY FIND_IN_SET( d.dept_id, CONCAT( t.tree_path, ',', t.dept_id ) ) SEPARATOR '/' ) AS full_path FROM sys_department t JOIN sys_department d ON FIND_IN_SET( d.dept_id, CONCAT( t.tree_path, ',', t.dept_id ) ) WHERE t.dept_id = #{deptId}
